items.body_raw: וישביעני לאמר לא־תקח אשה לבני מבנות הכנעני אשר אנכי ישב בארצו
items.answer_raw: And he made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I am dwelling.

items.body_raw: רְדָה
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. emph. imper. (from רֵד) Qal of ירד. Come down

items.body_raw: לָרֶדֶת
items.answer_raw: inf. cstr. Qal of ירד; with לְ. To go down

items.body_raw: דַּע
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. imper. Qal of ידע. Know (thou)

items.body_raw: דַּעַת
items.answer_raw: inf. cstr. Qal of ידע. Frequently used as a noun = knowledge

items.body_raw: נֵלְכָה
items.answer_raw: 1 plur. cohortative Qal (from נֵלֵךְ) of הלך. Let us go

items.body_raw: אִינַק
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. impf. Qal of ינק. I will suck

items.body_raw: תִּירָא
items.answer_raw: 2 sing. masc. or 3 sing. fem. impf. Qal of ירא. Thou wilt (or she will) fear

items.body_raw: הַנּוֹרָא
items.answer_raw: masc. sing. ptc. Niph. of ירא, with article. The one who is feared, or to be feared; the terrible

items.body_raw: אִוָּרֵשׁ
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. impf. Niph. of ירשׁ. I shall be (dispossessed =) impoverished, come to poverty

items.body_raw: וַיּוֹרֶשׁ
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. impf. Hiph. of ירשׁ, with waw consec. And he dispossessed, i.e. drove out

items.body_raw: וָאִישָׁנָה
items.answer_raw: 1 sing. cohortative Qal of ישׁן. And I slept

items.body_raw: תּוּקַד
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. fem. (or 2 sing. masc.) impf. Hoph. of יקד. It shall be kindled, burn

items.body_raw: בְּהוֹרִידִי
items.answer_raw: inf. cstr. Hiph. of ירד with בְּ and 1 sing. suffix. When I brought down

items.body_raw: תֵּרַדְנָה
items.answer_raw: 2 or 3 plur. fem. impf. Qal of ירד. Ye or they will come down

items.body_raw: וַיֹּרִדֻהוּ
items.answer_raw: 3 plur. masc. impf. Hiph. with waw consec. and 3 sing. masc. suffix (scriptio defectiva). And they brought him down

items.body_raw: הֻצַּע
items.answer_raw: 3 sing. masc. pf. Hoph. of יצע. It was spread

items.body_raw: מַצִּיג
items.answer_raw: masc. sing. ptc. Hiph. of יצג. One who sets or places

items.body_raw: וַנֵּדָעֵם
items.answer_raw: 1 plur. impf. Qal of ידע with waw consec. and 3 plur. masc. suffix. And we knew them

items.body_raw: יִירָשׁוּם
items.answer_raw: 3 plur. masc. impf. Qal of ירשׁ, with 3 plur. masc. suffix. They will possess them

items.body_raw: וַיֵּרֶד אַבְרָם מִצְרַיְמָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ אִמְרִי־נָא אֲחֹתִי אַתְּ לְמַעַן יִיטַב־לִי בַעֲבוּרֵךְ וַיִּקַּח אֹתָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וּלְאַבְרָם הֵיטִיב בַּעֲבוּרָהּ וַיְנַגַּע יהוה אֹתוֹ נְגָעִים גְּדֹלִים וַיֵּדַע כִּי אִשְׁתּוֹ הִיא
items.answer_raw: And Abram went down into Egypt, and he said to his wife, Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister, in order that it may be well with me for thy sake. And the king took her, and with Abram he dealt well for her sake. But Yahweh plagued him with great plagues, and he learned that she was his wife.

items.body_raw: אָמַר יהוה אֶל־אַבְרָם אֲנִי יהוה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים לָתֶת לְךָ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְרִשְׁתָּהּ וַיֹּאמַר אֲדֹנָי יהוה בַּמָּה אֵדַע כִּי אִירָשֶׁנָּה
items.answer_raw: Yahweh said to Abram, I am Yahweh who brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees to give thee this land to possess it. And he said, O Lord Yahweh, whereby shall I know that I shall possess it?

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֵלָיו שָׁאוֹל שָׁאַל הָאִישׁ לָנוּ וּלְמוֹלַדְתֵּנוּ לֵאמֹר הַעוֹד אֲבִיכֶם חַי הֲיֵשׁ לָכֶם אָח וַנַּגֶּד־לוֹ עַל־פִּי הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה הֲיָדוֹעַ נֵדַע כִּי יֹאמַר הוֹרִידוּ אֶת־אֲחִיכֶם
items.answer_raw: And the sons of Jacob said to him, The man asked about us and about our kindred, saying, Is your father still alive? have you a brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words. Could we possibly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

items.body_raw: וַיַּעֲזֹב אֶת־עֲצַת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר יְעָצֻהוּ וַיִּוָּעַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִים
items.answer_raw: And he forsook the counsel which the old men had given him, and he took counsel with the young men.

items.body_raw: הַבֹּטְחִים בַּיהוָה יֵלְכוּ וְלֹא יִיעָפוּ
items.answer_raw: Those that trust in Yahweh shall walk and not be weary.

items.body_raw: וזכרת את־כל־הדרך אשר הוליכך יהוה אלהיך זה ארבעים שנה במדבר לדעת את־אשר בלבבך התשמר מצותיו אם־לא
items.answer_raw: And thou shalt remember all the way which Yahweh thy God hath led thee now for forty years in the wilderness, to know what was in thy heart, whether thou wouldst keep his commandments or no.

items.body_raw: And the ark went upon the face of the waters.
items.answer_raw: וַתֵּלֶךְ הַתֵּבָה עַל־פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם

items.body_raw: Make me to know thy ways.
items.answer_raw: הוֹדִיעֵנִי נָא אֶת־דְּרָכֶיךָ

items.body_raw: And they said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? and she said, I will go.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלֶיהָ הֲתֵלְכִי עִם־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלֵךְ

items.body_raw: And he said, Cause every man to go out of the house; and there stood no man with him, when he made himself known to his brethren.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר הוֹצִיאוּ כָל־אִישׁ מִן־הַבַּיִת וְלֹא־עָמַד אִישׁ אִתּוֹ בְּהִתְוַדְּעוֹ אֶל־אֶחָיו

items.body_raw: And the man opened the doors of the house and went out to go on (dat.) his way.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּפְתַּח הָאִישׁ אֶת־דַּלְתוֹת הַבַּיִת וַיֵּצֵא לָלֶכֶת לְדַרְכּוֹ

items.body_raw: And the daughter of Pharaoh said to her, Take this child and nurse (suckle) it for me, and she took the child and nursed it.
items.answer_raw: וַתֹּאמֶר־לָהּ בַּת־פַּרְעֹה קְחִי אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד הַזֶּה וְהֵינִקִהוּ לִי וַתִּקַּח אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד וַתֵּינִקֵהוּ

items.body_raw: Behold I have heard that there is corn in Egypt, go down thither and buy us a little food.
items.answer_raw: הִנֵּה שָׁמַעְתִּי כִּי יֶשׁ־שֶׁבֶר בְּמִצְרָיִם רְדוּ־שָׁמָּה וְשִׁבְרוּ־לָנוּ מְעַט אֹכֶל

items.body_raw: And Yahweh said unto him, Go not down to Egypt, dwell in the land which I shall say unto thee.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה אַל־תֵּרֵד מִצְרָיְמָה שֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ

items.body_raw: And he was afraid and said, How terrible (ירא, Niph. ptc.) is this place!
items.answer_raw: וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמֶר מַה־נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה

items.body_raw: And he said, My son shall not go down, for his brother is dead and he alone is left, and should mischief befall him in the way in which ye shall go, then shall ye bring down my grey-hairs in sorrow to Sheol.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא־יֵרֵד בְּנִי כִּי־אָחִיו מֵת וְהוּא לְבַדּוֹ נִשְׁאָר וּקְרָאָהוּ אָסוֹן בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכוּ־בָהּ וְהוֹרַדְתֶּם אֶת־שֵׂיבָתִי בְּיָגוֹן שְׁאוֹלָה

items.body_raw: And Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his younger (little) son had done to him.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּיקַץ נֹחַ מִיֵּינוֹ וַיֵּדַע אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה לוֹ בְּנוֹ הַקָּטָן

items.body_raw: וּבְצִלּוֹ יֵשְׁבוּ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים
items.answer_raw: And in its shadow many nations used to dwell.

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה הָעַלְמָה יֹלֶדֶת בֵּן וְקָרָאת שְׁמוֹ עִמָּנוּ אֵל
items.answer_raw: Behold, the young woman is about to bear a son and she shall call his name Immanuel.

items.body_raw: אלה החקים והמשפטים אשר תשמרו בארץ אשר נתתי לכם לרשתה כל הימים אשר־אתם חיים על־האדמה כי עמי אתם
items.answer_raw: These are the statutes and the judgments which ye shall observe in the land which I have given you to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth, for ye are my people.

items.body_raw: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ
items.answer_raw: Happy are they that dwell in thy house.

items.body_raw: His daughter abode in her father's house two years.
items.answer_raw: יָשְׁבָה בִתּוֹ בְּבֵית אָבִיהָ שְׁנָתַיִם

items.body_raw: יֶלֶד יֻלַּד־לָנוּ בֵּן נִתַּן־לָנוּ
items.answer_raw: A child has been born to us, a son has been given to us.

items.body_raw: יוֹדֵעַ יהוה דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד
items.answer_raw: Yahweh knoweth the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

items.body_raw: I counsel thee, let all thy people be gathered together.
items.answer_raw: יָעַצְתִּי יֵאָסֵף כָּל־עַמְּךָ

items.body_raw: They found maidens coming out to draw water.
items.answer_raw: מָצְאוּ נְעָרוֹת יֹצְאוֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם

items.body_raw: A righteous man careth for the life of his beast.
items.answer_raw: יוֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּוֹ

items.body_raw: טוֹב יוֹם הַמָּוֶת מִיּוֹם הִוָּלְדוֹ
items.answer_raw: The day of death is better than the day of one's birth.

items.body_raw: וַיִּקַּח מִנְחָה לְאָחִיו עִזִּים מָאתַיִם וְאֵילִים עֶשְׂרִים וּגְמַלִּים מֵינִיקוֹת וּבְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים
items.answer_raw: And he took a present for his brother—two hundred she-goats, and twenty rams, and thirty milch camels and their colts.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם צְאוּ שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶם וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁלָשְׁתָּם
items.answer_raw: And he said to them, Come out, the three of you; and they came out, the three of them.

items.body_raw: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ מֵרוּחֶךָ
items.answer_raw: Whither shall I go from thy spirit?

items.body_raw: אִם־לֹא אֶל־בֵּית־אָבִי תֵּלֵךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ אִשָּׁה לִבְנִי
items.answer_raw: Thou shalt assuredly go to my father's house and take a wife for my son.

items.body_raw: And he said to her, My daughter, wilt thou go with this man, or wilt thou stay with me? and she said, Alas, my father, I cannot stay with thee.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ בִּתִּי הֲתֵלְכִי עִם־הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה אִם תֵּשְׁבִי עִמָּדִי וַתֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ אָבִי לֹא אוּכַל לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּךְ

items.body_raw: God never grows faint or weary: if ye believe in him, how can ye say, My way is hidden from my God? for he remembereth that we are dust, and evermore he giveth strength to the weary who put their trust in him.
items.answer_raw: לֹא יִיעַף אֱלֹהִים וְלֹא יִיגָע אִם תַּאֲמִינוּ בוֹ אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרוּ נִסְתְּרָה דַרְכִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי כִּי זָכוּר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ וְכֹחַ הוּא נֹתֵן לַיָּגֵעַ אֲשֶׁר יִבְטַח בּוֹ
